items.title: Michael Max Fleming interviewed by Monk Rowe, New Hartford, New York, June 8, 2017

ctx.x: Yeah but they were right there. They were right there. Well I was doing it with “Cleanhead” and then Scott. What was his name. The organ player that played.

No, no, this is a saxophone player. He was a genius. And I’m having trouble remembering names but yea, the answer is I played with, I can’t think of their names but there were a lot of local rhythm & blues bands that I played with. The main thing what he was saying is get experience playing. So I did that. And yeah, so I did that, and then I went on. You were asking me if I played with the bands and I’m saying yeah, even though I can’t — so I’m just trying to think, but they don’t come to mind. Okay but go on to…
